title: LEVELING AND WEIGHING - GENERAL
question: Which fuselage reference points are used to verify the lateral levelness of the aircraft during leveling procedures?
answer: Lateral Leveling. (1) The airplane may be leveled laterally by selecting two corresponding points on the upper door sills  and placing the level across these points. NOTE:  Out of level tolerance for wing tips is 3 inches total.(1) Locate two NAS221-7 screws on left side of fuselage at FS 139.65 and FS 171.65. (2) Remove screws and replace with studs of suitable length . (3) Place level on protruding studs. The screws located at FS 139.65 and FS 171.65 are on Water Line .

title: LEVELING AND WEIGHING - GENERAL
question: What is the method for checking lateral levelness of the aircraft using fuselage reference points at FS 139.65 and FS 171.65?
answer: Lateral Leveling. (1) The airplane may be leveled laterally by selecting two corresponding points on the upper door sills  and placing the level across these points. NOTE:  Out of level tolerance for wing tips is 3 inches total.(1) Locate two NAS221-7 screws on left side of fuselage at FS 139.65 and FS 171.65. (2) Remove screws and replace with studs of suitable length . (3) Place level on protruding studs. The screws located at FS 139.65 and FS 171.65 are on Water Line .
